t: This is the Business Design Centre, a Grade II listed building between Upper Street and Liverpool Road. It opened in 1862 as the Agricultural Hall, and became the Royal Agricultural Hall in 1884. It was home to the Smithfield Show until 1938, hosted the Royal Tournament from 1880, and held the first Crufts dog show in 1891. In the mid-1980s the businessman Sam Morris bought the hall and turned it into the Business Design Centre.
